receipt_note: The native run passed its first 23 assertions, including source selection, transfer, authenticated restart, cooldown and head preservation. After /skin clear, the test observer wrote the expected authenticated/alive profile with its own Ely texture and no selection. Gson omits null fields, so the harness indexed the absent selected key and stopped before recording its last assertion. An independent post-run assertion checked the saved before/after native JSON and passed. The original incomplete receipt and observer files are retained privately. The reader now uses get(selected); no application JAR was changed or unobserved functional result inferred.
limits: No graphical Java rendering or physical Bedrock client/controller session was performed. Signed profile transfer to a second Java network peer was verified.
Ely.by and Mojang may return missing profiles or temporary service errors. Existing skins remain unchanged on an explicit lookup failure.
Independent launcher skin systems can override server-provided skins locally.
Local fixture update checks for Grim/Plan were disabled; a known PacketEvents GitHub HTTP-403 update check is qualified separately when observed. Production dependency settings were preserved.
